ache.title: Guessing Jade’s meta value before she lands
ache.note: Nero reacts to Hoyoverse’s ‘Keeping Up With Star Rail’ program and guesses Jade’s value in Pure Fiction and follow-up teams. Those programs are ads, and a reaction video stretches the ad longer. Speculation feels like research, but mostly it builds want for a character nobody has played yet.
watch: Pure Fiction as the reason to want her
ache.tip: Let official programs play without you. Decide about a character after people have actually used her, or not at all.
lines: a reaction to an ad. very meta
speculation is just wanting with charts
she looks nice. nice isn’t a need

title: Jade: Pure Fiction Meta? Follow-up Best Support? | Honkai: Star Rail
excerpt: Hi everyone! Here, I comment the "Keeping Up With Star Rail" Hoyoverse program that just released, and focuses on Jade! I express my opinions about her value in meta composition, with special regards to Pure Fiction. I also speculate about her value in follow-up attack teams. Let me know about your opinion about the character, both from the gameplay and the esthetics side! Reaction to: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KzlTqWOAri8
